intro: We accept articles, case comments, and student notes year-round.

items.heading: Who can submit
items.text: Students and alumni of the College of Law, faculty members, and practitioners. Edit this to match your journal's policy.

items.heading: Manuscript format
items.text: Word document, 5,000 to 12,000 words, with an abstract of up to 200 words. Cite in the format your board follows and include all footnotes.

items.heading: Review process
items.text: The Editorial Board screens each manuscript, then assigns it for faculty review. Authors are notified of the decision by email.

items.heading: Rights and permissions
items.text: Authors keep their copyright and grant the journal the right to publish the work in print and online.
